title: The oldest iPhone model you can trade-in with Apple is older than you'd think - Engadget
summary: Even old Apple devices you haven’t touched in years could still get you some credit towards a new phone. Once your new phone arrives, transfer everything from your old device to the fresh one before preparing your old phone for trade-in .
